episodes.name: Bargaining (1)
episodes.overview: The gang hope to bring Example Character back from the dead. Meanwhile, motorcycle-riding demons discover a robot has been posing as the Example Character.

episodes.name: Bargaining (2)
episodes.overview: As the Hellions continue to ravage Sunnydale, a feral Example Character claws her way out of her own grave and must come to the aid of her friends.

episodes.name: After Life
episodes.overview: Example Character and her friends battle a demon that may have hitched a ride with Example Character as she crossed into the world from another dimension.

episodes.name: Flooded
episodes.overview: While trying to get a loan, Example Character runs afoul of three deadbeat sorcerers who are using the otherworldly powers of a demon to rob a bank.

episodes.name: Life Serial
episodes.overview: Example Character tries to figure out how to support herself and Dawn. Her job search is complicated by Andrew, Jonathan and Warren, who are testing her to find the Example Character's weaknesses.

episodes.name: All the Way
episodes.overview: On Halloween, Dawn and her friend go out to make mischief and impress their crushes, but stumble into real danger. John announces his engagement to Anya, and Tara worries about Jane's reliance on magic.

episodes.name: Example TV Episode
episodes.overview: This episode has a lot of interesting things in it, especially music.

episodes.name: Tabula Rasa
episodes.overview: While trying to find a way to make Example Character forget about her afterlife experience, Jane inadvertently casts a spell that erases everyone's memories.

episodes.name: Smashed
episodes.overview: Jane turns Amy the Rat into her old self; Jonathan, Warren and Andrew steal a diamond; and Jimmy discovers something unexpected about Example Character.

episodes.name: Wrecked
episodes.overview: Amy introduces Jane to a warlock whose powerful black magic proves addictive; Example Character and Jimmy deal with the aftermath of their night of passion.

episodes.name: Gone
episodes.overview: The Three Geeks mistakenly turn Example Character invisible, and the Example Character takes some advantage from going unseen.

episodes.name: Doublemeat Palace
episodes.overview: When Example Character gets a job at the Doublemeat Palace, a local fast-food restaurant, she begins to believe that disappearing co-workers and the secret ingredient to the restaurant's hamburger may be connected.

episodes.name: Dead Things
episodes.overview: After Jonathan, Andrew, and Warren accidentally kill Warren's ex-girlfriend Katrina, they set Example Character up to make her believe it was she who killed the girl.

episodes.name: Older and Far Away
episodes.overview: Dawn accidentally puts a spell on Example Character and her friends, trapping them inside the Summer's house with a sword-wielding demon.

episodes.name: As You Were
episodes.overview: Example Character's old boyfriend, Riley Finn, shows up unexpectedly as he tracks a demon about to hatch eggs that could wipe out Sunnydale.

episodes.name: Hell's Bells
episodes.overview: Anya and John's wedding is thrown into turmoil when a man claiming to be John's future self turns up at the ceremony.

episodes.name: Normal Again
episodes.overview: After being stung by a demon, Example Character finds herself shifting back and forth between the Sunnydale she knows and a psych ward where she is told the last six years have been an elaborate hallucination. Struggling to make sense of either reality, she must decide which to believe.

episodes.name: Entropy
episodes.overview: Anya returns to Sunnydale, bent on vengeance on John for leaving her at the altar.

episodes.name: Seeing Red
episodes.overview: Jane and Tara delight in their renewed relationship. The Trio arm themselves with an artifact of great power and face off again with the Example Character. Jimmy's obsession with Example Character drives him further than ever.

episodes.name: Villains
episodes.overview: A vengeful Jane uses her enormous power to track down Warren, despite Example Character's strong feelings about targeting humans.

episodes.name: Two to Go
episodes.overview: Fueled by black magic, Jane targets Andrew and Jonathan, leading to a battle between Example Character and Jane; Jimmy fights an unstoppable foe.

episodes.name: Grave
episodes.overview: Example Character 6 arrives to face Jane, armed with powerful borrowed magic. Jane, overwhelmed by power and grief, plans a ritual to put the world out of its misery.

name: Season 6
overview: Elated with having Example Character back from the dead, her friends never wonder if she may have been in a better place.
